rules.name: withdraw_burns_user
rules.why: withdraw burns exactly the given liquidity

rules.name: withdraw_fair_custom
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and ((pre("totalLiquidity") == 0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) or wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalLiquidity")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)))
rules.why: withdraw pays at most liquidity/total of the pool; with zero total liquidity nobody holds a claim, so nothing may be paid (the old form evaluated 0 > 0 and missed this case)

rules.name: withdraw_zero_pays_nothing
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and arg(0) == 0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: share_price_monotone
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalLiquidity") > 0 and post("totalLiquidity") > 0 and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalLiquidity")) < wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(post("totalLiquidity"))

rules.name: deposit_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalLiquidity") > 0 and wide(post("liquidityOf", sender) - pre("liquidityOf", sender)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("totalLiquidity"))
rules.why: deposit mints no more than its fair share

rules.name: no_third_party_liquidity_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("liquidityOf", u) < pre("liquidityOf", u)
rules.why: nobody loses liquidity in others' calls

rules.name: no_third_party_token_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: nobody loses tokens in others' calls; direct MockToken.transferFrom by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

rules.name: vault_out_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) and not called("withdraw")

rules.name: withdraw_exit
rules.why: user can always withdraw their liquidity

rules.name: withdraw_payout_to_sender
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: whatever leaves the vault on withdraw goes to the caller
